advancement.moderndelight.alcohol.desc: Ferment sweetened water into a bucket of alcohol.
advancement.moderndelight.alcohol.title: Moonshine
advancement.moderndelight.all_cake.desc: Collect all nine flower cakes. Cake can be a flower, apparently.
advancement.moderndelight.all_cake.title: Flower Power
advancement.moderndelight.all_fried.desc: Eat every fried food. Your cardiologist has been notified.
Make all five ice lollies. Brain freeze is a small price for happiness.
advancement.moderndelight.all_mousse.des: Collect all six mousses. The spelling has never been this delicious.
advancement.moderndelight.all_pudding.de: Collect all four puddings: apple, matcha, caramel, cherry. Cheap to make, expensive to resist.
advancement.moderndelight.all_tea.desc: Extract cherry milk tea, rose ice tea, and mango milk tea. Boba is a food group.
advancement.moderndelight.all_tea.title: Boba Time
advancement.moderndelight.bamboo_steamer: Build a traditional steamer: basket, cover, cauldron. Steam is just water with ambition.
advancement.moderndelight.battery.desc: Craft any battery. Storing power is the second-best thing to having power.
advancement.moderndelight.battery.title: Battery Included
advancement.moderndelight.battery4.desc: Craft a Dimensional Battery. Your storage problems are now in another dimension.
advancement.moderndelight.battery4.title: Is There No End to This Power?
advancement.moderndelight.bdc_bdi.desc: Craft a Biogas Digester Controller and an I/O Port. Read the instructions. Please. For once.
advancement.moderndelight.bdc_bdi.title: Biogas Industry
advancement.moderndelight.cabinet.desc: Get any cabinet. Your kitchen called; it wants to be taken seriously.
advancement.moderndelight.cabinet.title: Kitchen Makeover
advancement.moderndelight.chili.desc: Harvest a chili pepper. Eat it raw if you're feeling brave or stupid.
advancement.moderndelight.chili.title: Some Like It Hot
advancement.moderndelight.chili_sauce.de: Make chili sauce. Somewhere, a bottle of ketchup feels threatened.
advancement.moderndelight.click_gas_cook: Right-click a Gas Cooking Stove 10 times in 3 seconds. Drop the beat - and the stove. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.moderndelight.cooked_portabl: Cook instant noodles in a Portable Pot with quicklime and water. Nothing about this is convenient.
advancement.moderndelight.crab.desc: Catch a crab with the Trawler. No music required, but strongly recommended.
advancement.moderndelight.crab.title: Crab Rave
Craft a Cuisine Table. Put a tool on top, an ingredient below, and watch it have an existential crisis.
advancement.moderndelight.deep_fryer.des: Craft a Deep Fryer and a Deep Fry Basket. Oil, gas, and questionable decisions.
advancement.moderndelight.dim_sum.desc: Make shaomai, crystal dumplings, and both kinds of stuffed buns. Yum cha is a lifestyle.
advancement.moderndelight.dim_sum.title: Dim Sum Sunday
advancement.moderndelight.donut.desc: Bake two donuts and eat one. The hole doesn't count as calories.
advancement.moderndelight.donut.title: Donut Disturb
Stack bread, two cooked pork chops, cabbage, and cheese into a double burger. Your diet can wait.
advancement.moderndelight.electric_steam: Craft an Electric Steamer. Goodbye, cauldron-based architecture.
advancement.moderndelight.electric_whisk: Craft an Electric Whisk. Charge it at a Charging Post, then whisk dropped items directly. Peak laziness.
advancement.moderndelight.electricians_d: Craft an Electrician's Desk. It will be with you for a long time.
advancement.moderndelight.fermentation_t: Craft a Fermentation Tank. Fill it with liquid and bacteria, then hand it to the Industrial Fermenter.
advancement.moderndelight.fish_and_chips: Make fish and chips. Yes, it's a full meal. No, the peas are not included.
Deep-fry noodles, then wrap them in multifunctional wrapping paper to make instant noodles.
advancement.moderndelight.garlic.desc: Find wild garlic in forests, mountains, and taigas. Works on vampires; does nothing for your breath.
advancement.moderndelight.garlic.title: Vampires Hate This One Trick
advancement.moderndelight.gas_canister.d: Craft a Gas Canister. It carries gas for your stove and anxiety for your neighbours.
advancement.moderndelight.gas_cooking_st: Craft a Gas Cooking Stove. It heats food, pots, and - if you're careless - you.
advancement.moderndelight.get_advance_fu: Craft an Advanced Furnace and a Baking Tray. Four times faster, same amount of panic.
advancement.moderndelight.get_black_pepp: Find wild black pepper in the jungle. Yes, it's a jungle out there.
advancement.moderndelight.get_butter.des: Whisk cream in a Glass Bowl to churn butter. Everything you cook is now 40% more dangerous.
advancement.moderndelight.get_cheese.des: Ferment milk with lactobacillus until it turns into cheese. Say cheese - you're on camera.
advancement.moderndelight.get_cream.desc: Whisk a milk bucket in a Glass Bowl to make cream. It's not spoiled - it's upgraded.
advancement.moderndelight.get_crowbar.de: Craft a crowbar, then pry a block apart with it. Physics will cope.
advancement.moderndelight.get_crowbar.ti: Physics Is More of a Suggestion
advancement.moderndelight.get_egg_tart.d: Bake an egg tart: cream, mixed dough, egg, then sugar. The order matters, apparently.
advancement.moderndelight.get_freezer.de: Craft a Freezer. Finally, a place where your ingredients - and your temper - can chill.
advancement.moderndelight.get_oven.desc: Upgrade the Advanced Furnace into an Oven. Great Scott - it actually works.
advancement.moderndelight.get_oven.title: Bake to the Future
advancement.moderndelight.get_pizza.desc: Bake the raw pizza: black pepper, sugar, black pepper - in that order. Don't ask.
Place flattened dough, add five pizza ingredients, then finish with a layer of cheese.
advancement.moderndelight.get_start_desc: A simple mod guide begins here. Let's get cooking!
advancement.moderndelight.get_wheat_doug: Water plus flour plus regret. Roll it flat with a Kneading Stick, or don't - it's your dough.
advancement.moderndelight.glass_cup.desc: Craft a glass cup. Optimism, but drinkable.
advancement.moderndelight.got_amethyst.d: Craft an amethyst knife. Against squid, it's less a knife and more of a can opener.
advancement.moderndelight.got_cherry_bom: Throw a Cherry Bomb and let it explode. There's a zombie on your lawn; this should sort it out. (Hidden Advancement)
advancement.moderndelight.got_cuttlebone: Kill a squid with an amethyst knife and take its cuttlebone. Rich in calcium, low in dignity.
advancement.moderndelight.got_kebabs.des: Grill a squid tentacle kebab. Delicious, healthy, and slightly judgmental.
advancement.moderndelight.got_truffle.de: Break podzol to dig up a truffle. Pigs are optional; patience is not.
advancement.moderndelight.got_whisk.desc: A whisk, a glass bowl, and absolutely no idea what you're doing. Welcome to Modern Delight.
advancement.moderndelight.got_whisk.titl: The Truth Is It's a Whisk
advancement.moderndelight.ice_cream.desc: Watch an ice cream cone assemble itself. This is the peak of civilization.
advancement.moderndelight.ice_cream_make: Craft an Ice Cream Maker. The answer is nobody. It's nobody.
advancement.moderndelight.industrial_fer: Craft an Industrial Fermenter. Now the bacteria have a factory and a pension plan.
advancement.moderndelight.juice_extracto: Craft a Juice Extractor. Physics, but make it brunch.
advancement.moderndelight.matcha.desc: Grind leaves into matcha. A lot of ceremony for a green drink.
advancement.moderndelight.matcha.title: Much Ado About Matcha
advancement.moderndelight.not_spicy.desc: By constantly eating spicy food, and getting Mouth Afire V. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.moderndelight.opera_cake.des: Bake an Opera Cake. The first bite is chocolate; the second is an aria.
advancement.moderndelight.pg.desc: Craft a Photovoltaic Generator. Eco-friendly, and completely useless at night.
advancement.moderndelight.pg.title: Solar Punk
Smelt quartz into a silicon ingot. Somewhere, a startup just got funded.
advancement.moderndelight.soy_milk.desc: Squeeze soybeans into soy milk. Joy to the world, and to your breakfast.
advancement.moderndelight.soy_milk.title: Soy to the World
advancement.moderndelight.steamed_bun.de: Steam some dough into a bun. If it's not like Mom's, don't tell her.
advancement.moderndelight.stone_mortar.d: Craft a stone mortar. It's just rocks, but with a licence to grind.
advancement.moderndelight.tesla_coil.des: Craft a Tesla Coil and send power through the air. Edison is typing...
advancement.moderndelight.thermal_power_: Stirling Engine on a working furnace, flywheel to a Faraday Generator. The 19th century is impressed.
advancement.moderndelight.trawler.desc: Craft a Trawler. Why fish with a rod when you can fish with infrastructure?
advancement.moderndelight.trawler.title: Gone Fishin'
advancement.moderndelight.truffle_egg_ta: Eat a truffle egg tart. Congratulations, your dessert now has a market price.
Press oil with a Filter and an oil crop. Congratulations, deep-frying is now inevitable.
advancement.moderndelight.vinegar.desc: Ferment sweetened water or alcohol into a bucket of vinegar. It's not a failure; it's a condiment.
advancement.moderndelight.vinegar.title: Sour Grapes
advancement.moderndelight.wind.desc: Make a fan blade and a wind turbine controller. Free electricity, courtesy of the sky.
advancement.moderndelight.wind.title: The Wind Is Passing By
advancement.moderndelight.wither_lolly.d: Eat a Wither Ice Lolly. Side effects include decay, darkness, and regret. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.moderndelight.wither_rose_ca: Eat the Wither Rose Cake, then sit quietly and think about your life. (Hidden advancement)
advancement.moderndelight.wooden_basin.d: Craft a Wooden Basin. It presses oil by stomping. Your feet will never forgive you.

effect.moderndelight.gut_flora.descripti: Slower hunger drain and no food coma from hearty meals.

moderndelight.tooltip.fermentation_tank: A fluid storage tank with a capacity of 5 B can be used to transfer fermentation broth and fermentation microorganisms from industrial fermenters.
moderndelight.tooltips.acdcc: A bidirectional AC/DC converter. In AC->DC mode it converts and stores power from an AC generator, and can charge batteries. In DC->AC mode it outputs stored or battery power as AC. Adjust its efficiency in the GUI; FE, RF and AE conversion is also supported.
moderndelight.tooltips.baking_tray: A small, easy-to-use iron plate for upgrading an Advanced Furnace or stir-frying. Heat it with a Gas Cooking Stove, place food on top, then stir-fry it five times with a spatula.
moderndelight.tooltips.bamboo_steamer: A simple bamboo steamer, requires a cover, basket drawers, and a gas cooking stove heated cauldron filled with water, add the ingredients and it will start the process, a Steamer can be stacked 3 blocks high, each block can hold 4 layers.
moderndelight.tooltips.bdc: The core of a biogas digester. When a flat, completely sealed cuboid space exists beneath it, the controller recognizes it automatically.
moderndelight.tooltips.bdi: Activates when placed above a working biogas digester controller. Fill it with food to ferment it into biogas. Attach a gas canister to the side to fill it with biogas.
moderndelight.tooltips.butter: That sticky texture... maybe it's good for something besides food.
moderndelight.tooltips.charging_post: A device for charging DC appliances. Right-click to open the GUI. Place at least one battery in either of the two slots on the left, and the appliance to charge in the slot on the right.
moderndelight.tooltips.condiment_tip: Seasoning item, hold this in one hand and any food in the other hand to season the food.
moderndelight.tooltips.cuisine_table: The cuisine table allows you to deepen the ingredients and use it with a tool that breaks down the ingredients into more parts.
moderndelight.tooltips.cuttlebone: Dropped when a squid is killed with an amethyst tool.
moderndelight.tooltips.deep_fryer: A deep fryer for cooking a variety of foods. Add cooking oil, place a Gas Canister behind it, press the front button, then add food to start frying. Hold Shift and right-click to view its status.
moderndelight.tooltips.electric_steamer: Like a regular steamer, but it consumes AC power to heat the water and can only process 12 ingredients at once, it has the advantage of taking up little space and does not require additional heating equipment.
moderndelight.tooltips.electric_whisk: Like a regular whisk, it can be used with a glass bowl to enable whisking of food, but it will consume DC power and you will need a charging post to charge it. In addition, it is also effective to the drops on the ground.
moderndelight.tooltips.electricians_desk: The electrician's desk allows you to synthesize and process some complex circuit components or appliances, after placing the material correctly into the desk, click on the output button that appears in the GUI to start the synthesis. There are 3 different types of mini-games: 1. 2048 (by pressing WASD to synthesize the specified number); 2. Splicing of the circuit board (reproduce the pattern of the "?" screen, the screwdriver can remove the pattern); 3. Hanno's Tower (just move the left tower to the right, narrow blocks can only be placed on wide blocks); Finish the mini-game and then press that output button again to get the finished product.
moderndelight.tooltips.failed_seasoning: You can't add more seasoning to this food.
moderndelight.tooltips.fan_blade: A fan blade for wind power generation, which can be mounted on the wind turbine controller or placed elsewhere for decorative purposes, its rotation speed depends on the current altitude and weather conditions.
moderndelight.tooltips.faraday_generator: When properly mounted behind the flywheel of a Stirling engine, AC power is generated, be sure that the flywheel of the Stirling engine and the generator must look like they are just able to be connected in order to generate power.
moderndelight.tooltips.filter: A string filter for the wooden basin. It filters oil and sludge.
moderndelight.tooltips.freezer: A simple freezer, which can be used for storing items or cold processing some ingredients, can be cooled by consuming some refrigerants, such as ice, or by directly consuming AC electricity.
moderndelight.tooltips.gas_cooking_stove: When it is flanked by a gas canister containing gas, right-click to activate it, and when activated, it can heat up the block above it, including baking tray, oven, and Advanced Furnaces, all of which are compatible.
moderndelight.tooltips.glass_bowl: A container for processing and whisking ingredients that needs to be used with a whisk, water can also be poured into it for "mixing with water".
moderndelight.tooltips.holder: Safely remove items from the Deep Fryer and transfer items between containers. Right-click to release a held item; right-click while empty-handed to grab the item in your other hand.
moderndelight.tooltips.ice_cream_maker: Hold Shift and right-click to open the GUI. Add cream of any flavor, sugar, and eggs, then supply AC power. Select the flavors to mix, then hold an ice cream cone and right-click to serve.
moderndelight.tooltips.industrial_fermen: Harness the power of microbes to transform simple ingredients into fine wine, vinegar, and more.
moderndelight.tooltips.juice_extractor: A juice extractor that runs on AC power. Right-click while holding an ingredient to insert it; once both ingredients are loaded, right-click again to start the machine.
moderndelight.tooltips.need_food: You need to hold any food in your other hand.
moderndelight.tooltips.p_gen: A photovoltaic generator converts light energy into DC electrical energy and stores it, batteries can be plugged in and charged, and the amount of power generated depends on factors such as current altitude, time of day, weather, block light and sky light.It will also attempt to supply power to the DC-powered devices located behind it.
moderndelight.tooltips.spatula: It can be used with a heated tray to stir-fry foods.
moderndelight.tooltips.sterling_engine: Mount the Stirling Engine on a lit furnace, blast furnace, smoker, Advanced Furnace or Oven, then connect it to a Faraday Generator to produce AC power. A sponge dampens its noise.
moderndelight.tooltips.tesla_coil: The Tesla Coil can transmit AC power remotely, and when placed on a device that generates AC power it spreads the power over an area of 8 blocks east, south, west, north, up, and down. Enable the visualization in the GUI to see the 48-block area. AC appliances and other Tesla Coils in range receive power, while nearby mobs can be shocked and damaged.
moderndelight.tooltips.trawler: A device used for harvesting aquatic products; it can only be placed on the water's surface. Right-click to raise or lower the trawl net. When the trawl net is on the water's surface, press Shift and right-click to open the GUI. Bait is optional.
moderndelight.tooltips.turnip: A slight grudge from the author.
moderndelight.tooltips.whisk: A whisk that can be used to mix ingredients, or... whisk the brains of monsters?
moderndelight.tooltips.wooden_basin: Extract vegetable oil by adding an oil crop (such as stir-fried sunflower seeds) and a filter, then stand on the basin and jump. Collect the oil with a glass bottle or bucket.
moderndelight.tooltips.wooden_plate: A plate for displaying items. Right-click to place an item on it; sneak and right-click to rotate it.
moderndelight.tooltips.wtc: When the fan blades are properly installed, the controller will begin to operate and generate AC power, the amount of power generated depends on the current altitude and weather conditions.

modmenu.summaryTranslation.moderndelight: A more modern approach to ingredients.
